explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the only rich source of all good gifts, described in the chapter as the great God and Lord over all.
Physical possessions or material resources that often become a source of temptation for those who desire to be rich, which Paul warns against.
The fundamental cause of why people suffer; in this chapter, it is the love of money that is called the root of all evil.
One of the most important messages about being satisfied with food and clothing, regardless of how much one owns materially.
The eternal time or eternal life that God promises to believers, in contrast to temporary worldly wealth.
The holy scripture and God's revelation that must be held fast to live a righteous life.
The term used for the good fight of faith, where the Christian must struggle against sin and doubt to win eternal life.
